query: A new SSRN paper looks almost identical to my job-market paper. Our WP was public six months earlier; compare the actual public dates and tell me what earlier work, if any, pre-empts us.
这是我的博士论文proposal。请建立竞争论文地图，重点检查近两年的working papers，并说明哪些贡献可能已经不安全。
I replaced county-level aggregates with matched worker-firm records. Update the competitor radar and re-score the papers we were watching.
Set up a weekly monitor for new papers or revisions that could threaten my paper's primary contribution; notify me only for material changes.
Find methods papers I can borrow to validate an LLM-derived behavioral measure in my finance project, even if their substantive topic is different.
My coauthor thinks this conference draft kills our mechanism claim. Please compare the actual manuscript with our current fingerprint.
Search for job-market papers using account-level investor-manager matching that could overlap our contribution, and keep a durable registry so we can rerun this next month.
We use a confidential dataset. Build privacy-safe public queries and map the closest competing projects without exposing its name.
After the new experiment results, our main claim changed. Rebuild the novelty boundary and update the existing literature monitor.
I attached our full WP draft, but it may only have circulated privately. Before using a priority cutoff, check or ask when it first became publicly accessible.
Summarize the main argument of this famous paper in two paragraphs for my undergraduate class.
Write a thematic literature review on household finance with a smooth narrative and a clear research gap.
Fix the capitalization and DOI fields in my BibTeX bibliography and remove duplicate references.
Verify that every citation in introduction.tex supports the sentence attached to it and flag retracted sources.
Translate this English abstract into formal academic Chinese without changing the claims.
Help me derive the equilibrium in this signaling model and check whether Proposition 2 follows from the assumptions.
I need a list of ten recent papers about CEO overconfidence for a reading group; title and link are enough.
Turn these notes into a LaTeX research proposal with motivation, hypotheses, and an empirical plan.
Create a weekly general newsletter covering AI news and startup funding announcements.
Proofread my introduction for grammar, flow, and journal style while preserving all citations.
